**nano.md 0.5.0 — one command to become your Markdown app**

- **`nanomd --register`:** makes nano.md the app for `.md` and
  `.markdown` files, for your user only, with no admin rights.
  `nanomd --unregister` undoes it.
  - On Windows it registers nano.md and opens *Settings → Default apps*,
    where you make the final choice.
  - On macOS it sets nano.md as the handler through Launch Services.
  - On Linux it installs a `.desktop` file and runs `xdg-mime`.
- **Console output:** `nanomd --version` now prints in a Windows console.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.md).
